initial_goal.aim: become strong and rich. You came out of that volcano with nothing and got put down outside an inn like a stray cat. Never again. Fight what can be fought, take what work pays, count your money, and make sure nobody in this world mistakes you for a man to be carried twice.
initial_goal.done: you have a thousand credits to your name and you have beaten, in a fair fight, everything in this world that has ever knocked you down
